title: ED Overcrowding Validation Study
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to externally validate a new emergency department overcrowding estimation tool (SONET) developed at John Peter Smith Health Network (JPS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all adult patients visiting the emergency department or urgent care clinic at any one of the six participating sites during the allocated one month time period

Exclusion Criteria:

* those who do not meet inclusion criteria
study_population: all adult patients visiting any one of the six participating sites (one JPS ED or urgent care clinic or one of five Baylor emergency departments or urgent care clinics) during the allocated one month time period
